name: rules.transfer

get.description: Query native detail by ruleId; reads online without changing saved lists.

purpose: Inspect native configuration through inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: ruleId
fields.meaning: Native row identity, retained without conversion.

limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. Native fields, nested values, exact decimals and unknown fields are retained.
Native get sends ruleId as a string to GET /queryTransferRuleDetail.json; no implicit list lookup.
Single GET with fixed rowStart=0, pageSize=5000 and empty debitEntity/creditEntity arrays; no offset fallback.
Completeness requires raw arrivals = unique ruleId count = result.ruleCount. All native conditions remain intact; list summaries are independent of get.
